'''KPLink''' was a data service that maintained information on known [[Outlaw|criminals]]. It could be accessed by [[Security guard/Legends|security personnel]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including those aboard the [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']].
